term: truth-preserving local tolerance on a finite case chain
definition: Tolerance P n means every k<n satisfies P k → P(k+1). Boundary P n means some k<n satisfies P k and not P(k+1). P is a binary predicate; decidability is explicitly quantified only for boundary extraction. The index counts cases, not time, causes or grains in an empirically fixed heap.
note: Analyst profile comparing commitments; not attributed to an author. No perceptual indistinguishability or ability to know the boundary is asserted.
